summary: No reachable security issues. Workflow .github/workflows/style-bands.yml: workflow_dispatch only (no inputs, so nothing untrusted is interpolated into run: lines; not triggerable by fork PRs), top-level permissions contents: read, actions/checkout and actions/setup-node pinned to the same full SHAs as ci.yml/million.yml, timeout-minutes: 60, no secrets, no third-party actions, run: lines are literal constants. CLI (src/playtest/cli.ts): --check-styles is an exact-match valueless flag, rejected when duplicated, combined with --help, or combined with --replay-code; unknown options still rejected; checkStyles only adds an action hook and a report. The StyleCheck preflop step buffer is cleared on every hand, so memory is bounded per hand, and --hands is already capped by the existing parser. The bands parameter on main() is a test seam the entry never passes. No new dependencies, network, file I/O, randomness or secrets; package.json change only adds a test file to test:slow.
